classification: outcome-blind retrospective feasibility-corrected chronological test; not prospective, not confirmation, and not a rescue test
objective: Replace the structurally unreachable 90-minute replication with one nonoverlapping minimum-feasible window while preserving every parent formula, asset, cost, sample minimum, gate, ranking rule, and UNKNOWN truth rule.
claim_boundary: This protocol correction can provide one valid later falsification opportunity. It cannot overturn the 2026-08-30 liquidation falsification, promote Deribit to durable alpha, pool with the structurally invalid 90-minute replication, authorize deployment, or support capital allocation.

source_snapshot.use: Read and hash exactly the already-frozen byte prefixes; no live-tail bytes may enter this test.

protocol_correction.trigger: Independent post-outcome review proved the prior 90-minute window could supply at most five complete liquidation onset blocks and ten two-asset Deribit transitions versus registered minima of six and twelve.
protocol_correction.superseded_trial_disposition: Preserved as structurally-underpowered inconclusive. Its numeric gates remain descriptive only and it does not count as a falsification opportunity.
protocol_correction.single_changed_dimension: Observation duration increases from 90 to 105 minutes solely because seven aligned 15-minute blocks are the mathematical minimum that leaves six signal/onset blocks with complete next-15-minute outcomes.
protocol_correction.nonoverlap: The corrected window starts exactly at the prior window exclusive end and shares no market-data membership with it.
protocol_correction.unchanged: Parent formulas, assets, sides, costs, horizons, event/session rules, alignments, sample minima, gates, rankings, zero rules, UNKNOWN rules, and claim boundaries remain unchanged.
protocol_correction.multiplicity: Exactly one corrected outcome run. Do not pool with, extend from, or threshold-tune after either replication outcome.

observation_window.selection_rule: The immediately following nonoverlapping aligned window, using the mathematical minimum seven 15-minute blocks. Selection used no candidate-window price, return, cohort, GEX, RV, gate, or verdict.
observation_window.record_boundary: Metric records use authoritative exchange timestamps >= start and < end. Deribit outcome-block end may equal end only because every raw RV observation remains < end. Receipt time is capture availability, not exchange time.

liquidation.outcome_membership: P_0/P_5m/P_15m raw index observations must be < end; an onset without complete +15m alignment before end is excluded and reported.
liquidation.pre_window_context: Earlier control and forceOrder rows may establish continuous session and immediately prior same-symbol gap only; they never enter cohort counts or gates.

deribit.signal_membership: Signal block start >= start and every contributing option trade timestamp is < end.
deribit.outcome_membership: Every RV input observation is >= start and < end except the parent-permitted pre-block anchor up to 5000 ms; outcome-block end may equal end.
deribit.metadata_context: instrument.creation_timestamp is exchange provenance; received_ts_ms is capture availability and must be < end for metadata eligibility.

feasibility_proof.event_and_trade_count_note: The 20-onset and 1,000-trade minima depend on observed public activity and are not guaranteed; unlike block counts, they are not structurally capped below their minima.
feasibility_proof.machine_enforcement: The runner rejects misaligned, overlapping, or structurally unreachable windows before loading metric modules.

liquidation_btc_eth_post_onset.unchanged_decision_rule: Use the parent sample stop, six gates, and totalized truth table exactly. A pass cannot reverse the parent falsification.

deribit_intraday_taker_gex.unchanged_decision_rule: Use the parent sample stop, four gates, and totalized truth table exactly. Any unmet sample condition remains inconclusive.

snapshot_and_execution.input_integrity: Before metric code, verify contract, runner, parent rules, baseline artifacts, source manifest, every frozen prefix hash, structural feasibility, nonoverlap, and forceOrder/trade/BTC-index/ETH-index coverage through the exclusive end.
snapshot_and_execution.filter_order: Timestamp-filter the fixed window before return, GEX, RV, correlation, gate, or verdict computation. Post-window rows can establish input coverage only.
snapshot_and_execution.provenance: Emit every incomplete liquidation alignment with exact reason and keep instrument.creation_timestamp separate from received_ts_ms.
snapshot_and_execution.run_budget: Exactly one outcome-producing run per screen. Existing output paths are write-once and must never be overwritten.

inspected_before_freeze: All parent and structurally underpowered 00:00-01:30 trial outcomes and its independent review.
Source manifest paths, sizes, prefix hashes, first/latest timestamps, and parse counts.
Required-stream observation counts and first timestamps at or after the candidate 03:15 exclusive end, solely to establish input coverage.
Instrument creation and receipt timestamps needed to correct provenance labels.
not_inspected_before_freeze: Candidate-window forceOrder or option-trade membership and counts.
Candidate-window onset outcomes, GEX, RV, correlations, sample conditions, gates, or verdicts.

pre_freeze_review.initial_verdict: REJECT: required nonoverlap enforcement, relative contract-path normalization, and one shared liquidation filename predicate.
pre_freeze_review.corrections: All three issues were fixed and covered by the safeguard tests.
pre_freeze_review.final_evidence: Nonoverlap is derived from the hash-pinned superseded contract and enforced before outcomes; paths are resolved; coverage and metric code share _is_liquidation_capture; no new blocker found.
